sql: SELECT count(*) FROM orders
SELECT status, count(*) FROM orders GROUP BY status

SELECT r.name AS region, sum(o.total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY revenue DESC
SELECT date_trunc('month', created_at) AS month, sum(total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT id, total_amount, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY total_amount DESC) AS rnk FROM orders LIMIT 100

WITH m AS (SELECT manager_id, sum(total_amount) AS s FROM orders WHERE manager_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1) SELECT mg.full_name, m.s FROM m JOIN managers mg ON mg.id = m.manager_id ORDER BY m.s DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT name FROM regions UNION ALL SELECT name FROM cities
SELECT CASE WHEN total_amount > 500000 THEN 'big' ELSE 'small' END AS size, count(*) FROM orders GROUP BY 1
SELECT full_name FROM customers WHERE id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE total_amount > 5000000)
SELECT count(*) FROM customers c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id)
SELECT count(*) FROM returns WHERE reason = 'DROP TABLE orders'
SELECT count(*) AS deleted FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled'
SELECT count(*) AS update_count, max(created_at) AS last_insert FROM orders
SELECT f.fiscal_year, f.fiscal_quarter, sum(o.total_amount) FROM orders o JOIN fiscal_calendar f ON f.date = o.created_at::date GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '30 days'
SELECT sum(amount) FROM payments WHERE paid_at >= '2026-07-01' AND paid_at < '2026-10-01'
SELECT coalesce(sum(r.amount), 0) FROM returns r
SELECT p.name, coalesce(sum(i.quantity), 0) AS units FROM products p LEFT JOIN order_items i ON i.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT customer_id, count(*) FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING count(*) > 10
SELECT DISTINCT segment FROM customers
SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total_amount) FROM orders
SELECT extract(year FROM created_at) AS y, count(*) FROM orders GROUP BY 1
SELECT name FROM regions WHERE name ILIKE 'алмат%'
SELECT count(*) FROM products WHERE price BETWEEN 10000 AND 50000
SELECT full_name || ' (' || segment || ')' AS label FROM customers LIMIT 5
SELECT count(*) /* число заказов */ FROM orders -- итого
SELECT d::date AS day, count(o.id) FROM generate_series('2026-09-01'::date, '2026-09-30'::date, interval '1 day') AS d LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.created_at::date = d::date GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT count(*) FROM public.orders
SELECT "status", count(*) FROM "orders" GROUP BY "status"
SELECT c.full_name, last.created_at FROM customers c CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT o.created_at FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS last LIMIT 10
SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE channel = 'online' INTERSECT SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE channel = 'store'
SELECT id FROM customers EXCEPT SELECT customer_id FROM orders
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'cancelled') AS cancelled, count(*) AS total FROM orders
WITH a AS (SELECT customer_id, count(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY 1), b AS (SELECT n, count(*) AS customers FROM a GROUP BY n) SELECT * FROM b ORDER BY n
SELECT round(avg(total_amount), 2) FROM orders
SELECT count(*) FROM returns WHERE reason <> 'a;b'
SELECT name FROM products WHERE is_discontinued
SELECT count(*) FROM customers WHERE lower(full_name) LIKE '%ахмет%'
SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE created_at::date = 'yesterday'
SELECT o.id, p.amount FROM orders o JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id WHERE o.customer_id = 42
SELECT STATUS, COUNT(*) FROM ORDERS WHERE CREATED_AT >= '2026-01-01' GROUP BY STATUS
select o.Total_Amount from Orders O where O.ID = 1
